CustomField.description: Written by: the create leg and the ladder. WHERE THE IDENTITY FACTS ON THIS ROW CAME FROM, which is a different question from where the evidence came from. THE PROVENANCE BOUNDARY (wiring proposal v3, section 2): the ESTABLISHMENT is evidence-bound and the IDENTITY is not. Last name, email and title arriving from a Contact match or an enrichment partner are SOURCED FACTS carrying their own provenance; they are never rendered as verbatim, never blended into a quote, and never citable as speech. This field is what lets a reader tell the two apart on one row. Utterance means the only identity we hold is the name as heard.
CustomField.label: Identity Provenance
